A Public Use Microdata Area covers at least 100,000 people, so the mix of household types comes from a wider area than the study area itself.

Each zone's fitted totals are compared against the margin of error the Census publishes for the same figure. At tract level those margins are large — commonly half the estimate itself for a single household-size or age cell — so a fitted total inside the margin is as close to the source as the source's own precision can justify, and a fitted total outside it is a real disagreement worth reading.
All 704 zones reproduce their published totals to within the margin of error the Census publishes for those totals.
ActivitySim behavioural coefficients carry separate provenance for each component. A population drawn from local survey records does not make the travel behaviour local.
One retained household-resident realization; group quarters are excluded and unassessed. Shared inputs do not establish full population coverage, scientific accuracy or local behavioral calibration.
Missing cells contribute zero to existing category targets; this does not establish observed zero.
Age controls scale all-person ages by the zone household-population share; household-specific ages are unassessed.
Absent universe cells use the existing share default; raw cells and absence remain retained.
Household WGTP drives fitting; fetched person PWGTP is not fitted independently.
PUMAs are selected from centroid extent plus margin, not exact selected polygon coverage.

Auto ownership uses the nationally estimated component accepted by the recorded fresh holdout study. Every other behavioral component still uses ActivitySim's stock prototype_mtc coefficients estimated for the San Francisco Bay Area. Component acceptance does not establish destination, mode, timing, assignment, or corridor accuracy.
All five skim periods carry the same free-flow travel time; congestion by time of day is not represented.

Opt-in GTFS transit status: available. Unknown fares and unavailable paths disable mode-choice alternatives. Time-of-day skims represent the configured departures, not period averages. See the transit custody and limitations in mtc_inputs.skim_expansion.transit.
Household incomes were deflated to year-2000 dollars (BLS CPI-U annual averages 172.2/255.657, source dollar year 2019) because the MTC specifications segment income in 2000 dollars.
School and college enrolment come from ACS table B14001, which counts enrolled residents of each zone, not seats at schools located there.
Employment sectors FPSEMPN, AGREMPN and MWTEMPN are zero because the screening land-use source does not distinguish them; uncategorised employment is carried in OTHEMPN.
Zone densities and area types are computed over gross zone acreage; a large, mostly undeveloped zone reads as more rural than its developed core is.
